short_description: A waterproof, rechargeable cycling headlamp that lights the road wherever you look and helps drivers see you on early and late rides. The adjustable band fits over a helmet, cap or beanie, and it's just as handy for night hikes, camping and night game drives across Kenya.
description:
Riding home after dark on a Nairobi road, or pedalling back to camp after a late ride through Hell's Gate, you need to see the road and be seen by everyone on it. A handlebar light points wherever your wheel points, not where you're looking. A cycling headlamp puts bright LED light exactly where your eyes go, so you can spot potholes, gravel and loose stones before you hit them, and drivers can see you coming.

This cycling headlamp is waterproof, so a sudden downpour or a muddy splash won't cut your light when you need it most. It's rechargeable, which saves you buying batteries and means you can top it up from a power bank on longer trips. The adjustable band fits over a cycling helmet, a cap or a beanie, and it's just as useful off the bike for hiking, camping and night game drives.

Why Choose This Cycling Headlamp?

Head-mounted light gives you an advantage a bike light can't. When you turn your head to check a junction, a corner or a bump on the trail, the light turns with you. That makes a cycling headlamp the ideal partner to a handlebar light, or a simple, lightweight option on its own for commuters, gravel riders and mountain bikers.

Because it's waterproof and rechargeable, one cycling headlamp covers almost every outdoor job. For a light built mainly for hiking and camping, compare it with our Waterproof Rechargeable Headlamp, or choose the simple LED Headlamp for Running, Camping & Hiking for early runs and short trips.

Key Features

  • Bright LED light for riding, hiking and camping after dark
  • Waterproof design for rain, mud and splashes
  • Rechargeable, so there are no batteries to buy
  • Adjustable band that fits over a helmet, cap or beanie
  • Hands-free light that follows where you look
  • Lightweight and compact for any ride or pack

Benefits

Here's what a cycling headlamp adds to your rides and trips:

  • See every hazard: Light follows your eyes, so you spot potholes and stones in time.
  • Be seen: A head-height light helps drivers and other riders notice you.
  • Ride in any weather: Waterproof protection keeps it working in the rain.
  • Lower running costs: Recharge it instead of buying batteries.
  • One light, many uses: Cycling, hiking, camping, game drives and power cuts.

Perfect For

  • Evening and early-morning bike commutes
  • Mountain biking and gravel rides
  • Night hikes and sunrise climbs
  • Camping and moving around the campsite
  • Night game drives in private conservancies
  • Power cuts and roadside repairs

Where to Use a Cycling Headlamp in Kenya

A cycling headlamp is useful anywhere you ride as the light fades. Commuters on Nairobi's roads, riders on the Karura Forest and Ngong Forest trails, and groups cycling through Hell's Gate National Park all benefit from clear, hands-free light. Gravel riders heading out on the Kedong Valley or Magadi roads often start before sunrise and finish after dark.

Off the bike, it's a great light for hikes up Mt Longonot or Ngong Hills that start in the dark, and for camping at Naivasha or in the Aberdares. Night game drives are allowed in private conservancies such as those around the Maasai Mara, Ol Pejeta and Laikipia, and a headlamp keeps your hands free for binoculars and your camera.

Being visible is one of the most important parts of riding safely at night, alongside reflective clothing and a rear light. You can read more about safe riding in this overview of bicycle lighting. For anyone who rides, hikes or camps after dark, a waterproof, rechargeable cycling headlamp is a small upgrade with a big safety payoff.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I wear a cycling headlamp over my helmet?

Yes. The adjustable band fits around most cycling helmets, as well as caps and beanies. If you have an unusual helmet shape, message us and we'll help you check the fit.

Do I still need a bike light?

A headlamp lights where you look, while a handlebar light lights where you're heading. Many riders use both for the best view and visibility, and always add a red rear light on the road.

Is it safe to use in the rain?

Yes. This cycling headlamp is waterproof, so rain and splashes won't stop it working. Avoid fully submerging it unless the product label says it's rated for that.

How do I charge it?

It's rechargeable, so you charge it rather than replacing batteries. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the charging cable type and run time for this model.
